blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Opposing counsels in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday clashed over the use of the Tagalog word “yaman” to refer to her net worth in the statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN). It was private prosecutor James Bryan Ibrahim Alih who mentioned the word “yaman” during his direct examination of witness Karen Batu, the officer in charge of the Ombudsman Records Division. “How much is the net worth—or what is the Tagalog word for net worth? Yaman? Yaman. Sorry, I’m not a Tagalog speaker, Madam Witness…” Alih asked. Defense Justin Nicol Gular then suggested that […]...
